name: Decanter centrifuge

design.materialOfConstruction: Hastelloy C-276 (N10276) + WC or ceramic hardfacing

reviewFindings: Draft process basis only; no approved ratings, capacity, control loops or protective setpoints are asserted.
Model route alignment and destination qualification remain open under A300-001.

identity.designConcept: Automatic membrane filter press (PP plates, PTFE cloth, ≈ 70 chambers of 1,500 mm) with a 1.5 pore-volume displacement cake wash: 90 % of the cake liquor to T-304 and the concentrator, ≈ 0.65 t/d H₂SO₄ left in the washed cake (decanter V1.1: 14.2 t/d); gated on M1, decanter with repulp wash the fallback
